select r.* from notice_announcement_recipient r join notice_announcement a on a.id = r.announcement_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and (a.valid_start_time is null or a.valid_start_time <= #{now}) and (a.valid_end_time is null or a.valid_end_time > #{now})
and r.read_status = 'UNREAD'
and r.confirm_status = 'PENDING'
and (a.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by a.pinned desc, a.publish_time desc, r.created_at desc
select count(1) from notice_announcement_recipient where announcement_id = #{announcementId} and read_status = 'READ'
select count(1) from notice_announcement_recipient where announcement_id = #{announcementId} and confirm_status = 'PENDING'
select count(1) from notice_announcement_recipient where announcement_id = #{announcementId} and confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED'
